exposure: insulin use in gestational maternal diabetes
outcome: Inter-ventricular septal thickness/LV posterior wall ratio (IVS/LVPW)
cohort: The study included 528 healthy neonates (114 small for gestational age infants and 414 appropriate for gestational age infants) born >35 weeks' gestation at a single center.
finding: Perinatal factors significantly influence left ventricular parameters in small for gestational age infants, with birth weight identified as the most influential factor.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight for SGA infants was 2318g and for AGA infants was 3381g.
gest_age: Babies were born >35 weeks' gestation, with mean GA of 38.05 weeks for SGA and 38.54 weeks for AGA infants.
